name: ForecastTimeline
description: Stacked per-product forecast stepper cards floating above the main timeline. One card per active forecast layer, each with independent tick stepping and playback. Origin date always tracks the main TimeUI selection. All times shown in PDT.

components.name: Forecast Playback (Experimental)
components.description: Adds a play button to each forecast card that prefetches the run and animates through its steps. Experimental: playback smoothness varies by product — HRRR wind fields animate from memory, while tile-based products (WFPI, COG rasters) refetch each frame and can flicker.

components.name: Per-Hour Availability (Experimental)
components.description: Checks each HRRR forecast hour against NOAA's GRIB index instead of judging the whole run from forecast hour 0. A run publishes its hours one at a time, so this marks the card available as soon as any hour is out, darkens the hours that are not, and gives each dark hour a retry button. Costs one small request per forecast hour per run, shared across every HRRR card.
